question: Perennial snow is a characteristic of the cold climate group which is denoted as _____ letter code according to the Köppen classification of climate types.
solution:
The correct answer is **__EF__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Koppen climate classification system is the most widely used weather classification system.
 
• **Wladimir Peter Koeppen developed Koppen's scheme** of climate classification in **1884**, establishing a close relationship between the distribution of climate and vegetation.
 
• The Koppen climate classification types are determined by annual and monthly precipitation and temperature averages.

 Köppen Climate Classification Group
 Characteristics of Köppen’s Climate Classification
 
 
 
 

 A- Tropical
 The average coldest month temperature is 18° C or higher
 
 

 B- Dry Climates
 Potential evaporation surpasses precipitation
 
 

 C- Warm Temperate (Mid-latitude)
 The average coldest month temperature is higher than minus 3°C but below 18°C
 
 

 D- Cold Snow forest
 The average coldest month temperature is -3° C or less
 
 

 E- Cold Climates
 The average temperature for all months is less than 10° C
